decision: The exact remaining blocker is an immutable pre-2023 signal artifact or a physically pre-2023-isolated upstream source. The current RD16B producer and stored 1H timestamp semantics are now source-bound, but the mixed signal producer and crossing raw row groups cannot be used to claim protected-year-safe materialization.
resolved_semantics: The true mixed signal writer is run_rd26_exit_architecture.main.
The required nine-strata signal constructor mapping remains frozen by human authority.
RD16B stored timestamp is BAR_CLOSE_TIME in UTC.
Complete 1H OHLCV is causally available at or after stored timestamp.
Max-exit future-bar existence is an administrative coverage requirement, not a causal signal input.
